verdict.rationale: Meltano's CLI can manage projects, plugins and pipelines, and stream selection lets you choose many streams and properties at once. Marketing also claims you can run all pipelines in one place. That amounts only to implied, glancing support for batch-style operations, not documented bulk operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch commands (e.g., acting on many plugins, pipelines or jobs in one invocation), documentation of multi-item operations, and hands-on corroboration.
